title: The Hollow Garden
author: Edmund Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Voss, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
